title.rendered: 2018-19 Sherwood School District Ticketed Event Safety Protocols – K through 12th grade

content.rendered:
In our continual effort to ensure students are as safe as possible during high school sporting events and activities, changes are being made to our entrance protocols for all SSD ticketed events.  Large bags and backpacks; outside food and beverages (empty water bottles ok); and bikes, skateboards and scooters will no longer be allowed inside the venue. Unfortunately there will be no storage available on site for prohibited items, however there will be places to lock bikes and skateboards outside the venue.  

 Bag Restrictions

  • No large bags or backpacks
  • Medically necessary bags are acceptable

 Prohibited items

  • Bicycles
  • Skateboards
  • Scooters
  • Weapons
  • Fireworks
  • All outside food and beverages
  • Other potentially dangerous objects

 Allowed Items

  • Medically necessary bags and liquids, though subject to inspection
  • Empty liquid containers
